<template>
	<section
		ref="receipt"
		class="approved-result-receipt"
		:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptSummary')"
	>
		<AsamDescriptions :column="narrow ? 1 : 2" direction="vertical" class="receipt-summary"
			><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptSubject')">{{
				i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptSubjectValue')
			}}</AsamDescriptionsItem
			><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptNumber')">
				SQ-20261030-018 </AsamDescriptionsItem
			><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptApplicant')">{{
				i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptApplicantValue')
			}}</AsamDescriptionsItem
			><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptAmount')">
				¥24,680.00
			</AsamDescriptionsItem></AsamDescriptions
		><AsamSteps
			v-if="input.kind === 'success' && input.confirmed"
			:active="1"
			:direction="narrow ? 'vertical' : 'horizontal'"
			:space="narrow ? 72 : undefined"
			finish-status="success"
			class="receipt-progress"
			><AsamStep :title="i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptSubmitted')" /><AsamStep
				:title="i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptReview')" /><AsamStep
				:title="i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptProcessing')"
		/></AsamSteps>
	</section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamDescriptions, AsamDescriptionsItem, AsamSteps, AsamStep } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { ResultInput } from '../Types.js';
import { useTemplateI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
defineProps<{ input: ResultInput }>();
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
const narrow = shallowRef(false);
const receipt = ref<HTMLElement>();
let observer: ResizeObserver | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
		if (entry) narrow.value = entry.contentRect.width < 640;
	});
	if (receipt.value) observer.observe(receipt.value);
});
onUnmounted(() => observer?.disconnect());
</script>

<style scoped>
.approved-result-receipt {
	width: min(100%, 680px);
	margin: 24px auto;
	text-align: left;
}
.receipt-summary {
	padding: 24px;
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-container, 8px);
	background: var(--result-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--result-line);
}
.receipt-progress {
	padding: 32px 16px 12px;
}
.approved-result-receipt :deep(.el-descriptions__label),
.approved-result-receipt :deep(.el-descriptions__content) {
	line-height: 1.75;
}
.receipt-progress :deep(.el-step__title) {
	line-height: 2;
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	.receipt-summary {
		padding: 18px;
	}
}
@media (min-width: 720px) {
	.receipt-summary :deep(.el-descriptions__table) {
		table-layout: fixed;
	}
}
</style>
